units.source_text: 如今是春天，虽不是金钟儿鸣叫的秋天，

en.t: Now it was spring, not the autumn when the bell crickets chirped,

units.source_text: 而且在枫树树干的洞里，今年也开了紫花地丁，

en.t: and in the hollow of the maple trunk, violets had bloomed again this year,

units.source_text: 千重子想起壶中的金钟儿，并不是没有缘由的。

en.t: so there was a reason Chieko remembered the bell crickets in the jar.
